verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains nothing about test mode, sandbox keys, test documents, personas, or magic values that deterministically produce verified, failed, or requires-review outcomes. The docs cover session creation, webhooks, result access, flows, review tools and going-live branding, but never a test harness for exercising outcomes. Sandbox testing is a fair question for an identity-verification API, so this is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a developer, a sandbox lets me exercise every outcome before going live — documented test documents, personas, or magic values that deterministically produce pass, fail, and review results
